prompt:

Draw a NEW INDEPENDENT animation pose, using input1 for directional IDENTITY/CAMERA/SCALE only and input2 for character detail only and input3 for approved bright clean hand-painted Daoist chibi STYLE only. DO NOT preserve input pose. Exactly one full-body character, RIGHT SIDE PROFILE facing EAST (screen-right). Brown tousled tuft hair, jade/gold yin-yang hairpiece and plain teal ribbon, forehead jade diamond, charcoal gold-cloud short robe, ivory sleeves, jade belt, black/gold shoes. Anatomical RIGHT hand grips ONE large black-shaft brush with gold/jade collars and white bristles ending in dark tip. The brush has ONE teal tassel attached ONLY to the rounded HANDLE BUTT opposite the bristles, NEVER to bristle ferrule, and no yin-yang medallion. Anatomical LEFT hand holds ONE blank ivory scroll with two black/gold rods and its own yin-yang charm, exactly TWO pale-cyan spirits separately hover beside scroll. No swapped hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, floating parts. Square transparent RGBA native>=1024, retain head diameter and camera, feet at92% height without zoom/global translation. Maintain transparent margin on all sides; no magic, effects, shadow, ground, backdrop or labels. Short attack in place, never running. 
EXACT POSE: Frame01 of12 EARLIEST anticipation. Nearly upright ready stance with only a VERY SLIGHT knee bend, NOT a wide lunge. Both feet close to idle width. RIGHT elbow begins folding back beside waist; RIGHT fist is near lower chest, the brush points DIAGONALLY DOWN RIGHT at45 degrees, only beginning to lift from idle and NOT horizontal. Left elbow draws the blank scroll slightly closer from front to hip, not stretched behind. Eyes watch right, chin slightly tucked. DO NOT show a forward thrust or deep crouch.
